newsitem.title: USA: Norfolk Southern to start Conrail tender.
newsitem.headline: Norfolk Southern to start Conrail tender.

text.p: Norfolk Southern Corp said it will amend its tender offer for Conrail Inc on Wednesday to reflect its latest proposal to buy 9.9 percent, or 8.2 million shares, of the railroad for $115 per share.
Unless otherwise extended, the 9.9 percent tender will expire at midnight EST on February 4.
The move by Norfolk Southern follows Friday's meeting of Conrail shareholders in which they rejected a crucial measure in the proposed merger of Conrail and CSX Corp.
Spurned bidder Norfolk Southern last week said it would start a tender for 9.9 percent of Conrail if shareholders defeated the provision.
Norfolk Southern also said it would start a second tender offer for the remaining Conrail shares at $115 each after it completes the 9.9 percent tender.
